chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Talaqani (may Allah be pleased with him) told us, saying: Abu Ahmad Abdul-Aziz ibn Yahya ibn Ahmad ibn Isa al-Jaloudi al-Basri told us, saying: Muhammad ibn Sahl told us, saying: Al-Khadhr ibn Abi Fatima al-Balkhi told us, saying: Wahb ibn Nafi' told us, saying: Kadih told me from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his fathers, from Ali (peace be upon them).

Regarding the saying of Him, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'Peace be upon the Family of Yasin.' He said: Yasin is Muhammad (Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family), and we are the Family of Yasin.

key_terms.الصَّادِق: The Truthful (title of Ja'far ibn Muhammad)
key_terms.يَاسِينَ: Yasin (interpreted as a title for the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: Who is Yasin in the phrase 'Peace be upon the Family of Yasin' according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) interprets the Quranic phrase 'Peace be upon the Family of Yasin' by identifying 'Yasin' as the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his Ahl al-Bayt as his family. This exegesis highlights the unique spiritual status of the Prophet's household, connecting them directly to the honorific address found in the Quran, a view supported by various Shia exegetes who see 'Yasin' as a title for the Prophet or a reference to his lineage. The hadith underscores the theological significance of the Ahl al-Bayt as the recipients of divine peace, reinforcing their role as the spiritual heirs of the Prophet.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Muhammed bin Ibrahim bin Ishaq al-Talaqani, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Abu Ahmad, Abdul-Aziz bin Yahya bin Ahmad bin Isa al-Jaloudi al-Basri, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Sahl, that he said: We were told by Khidr bin Abi Fatima al-Balkhi, that he said: We were told by Wahab bin Nafe’, that he said: I was told by Kadih, from al-Sadiq, Ja’far bin Muhammed, from his father, from his fathers, from Ali, peace be upon him,

with regards to the saying of Him, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Peace be upon the Family of Yasin.» [1] He said: Yasin is Muhammed, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, and we are the Family of Yasin.
